assets.name: miron
assets.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: two-frame idle sprite sheet for Shattered Pixel Dungeon NPC Miron. Edit target Image 1: current 16x16 Miron, a straw-hatted farmer with brown moustache, cream shirt, muted green waistcoat, brown trousers and boots. Image 2 is a comparison with the real warrior, lumberjack and Miron; use the final farmer as identity. Image 3 shows actual hero idle frame pairs: follow their very simple pixel language and tiny head-turn animation. Main request: repair Miron's strange eyes and create TWO consistent idle frames with a small head turn, matching actual 16x16 game resolution. Output a single transparent 2:1 horizontal sheet, conceptually EXACTLY 32x16 logical pixels, each logical pixel an identical flat-color square, nearest-neighbor enlarged 32x to 1024x512. Left 16x16 cell: neutral three-quarter head. Right 16x16 cell: the SAME body, feet, arms, clothing and baseline in EXACTLY the same positions; only head/hat turn slightly to glance sideways. Character footprint around 12x15 logical pixels in each 16x16 cell, boots on row 15, empty margins. Crucial face: warm plain skin with very small simple dark brown eyes (one logical pixel per visible eye); a clear bridge of skin between eyes; compact brown moustache below a tiny nose. NO large white eye band, NO spectacles, NO glowing eyes, NO oversized eyeballs, NO facial checkerboard, NO smile line resembling extra eyes. Preserve broad head and short body/legs of heroes. Keep hat, moustache, cream shirt, green vest and brown boots recognizable. Flat restrained palette of roughly 16 colors; crisp square pixels with no antialiasing, outlines soft dark brown not large pure-black masses. No rake, no box, no props, no text, no grid, no shadow outside sprite, no checkerboard background. Exact frame registration and truly transparent background are essential.
assets.preparation: Two alpha crops, 12x15 inside 16x16 cells; nearest sampling at x+0.5, y+0.85; 27-color palette; identical body below row 8. Sheet 32x16. No CLI/API used.

assets.name: senogryz
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production bitmap asset for Shattered Pixel Dungeon, extremely low resolution classic pixel art, muted earthy colours, dark one-native-pixel outlines, broad simple clusters of solid colour, NO antialiasing, NO subpixel details, NO smooth gradients, NO lettering, NO grid, NO ground or shadows. GENUINE transparent background. Render as large uniform square pixels, suitable for nearest-neighbour reduction to native resolution. ONE sprite sheet of the SAME cat-sized burrowing hay beetle in FOUR 16x16 logical-pixel cells arranged 2 by 2, transparent empty margins between silhouettes. Full canvas exactly 32x32 logical pixels. Top left: idle facing three-quarter right. Top right: walking, same silhouette with forelegs forward. Bottom left: crouched charge wind-up with rake-like front legs scraping the soil. Bottom right: dead beetle on side. Beetle has squat broad dark brown chitin shell, a few dry golden hay stems on its back, six short legs, two broad rake-like front claws, small dark head with amber eyes. Actual tiny game enemy sprite proportions, creature occupies 14x12 pixels per cell, same size in each cell. No scenery.
